Longitudinal Transmission and Dyad Sharing Heatmap

Source: R/type_sharing_heatmap.R
type_sharing_heatmap.Rd

Creates publication-ready discrete sharing heatmaps (Clinical Archetype 28) to display bacterial strain transmission across mother-infant dyads, clinical (e.g. baseline infancy T1 versus 12 months T3).

Usage

type_sharing_heatmap(
  status_col = NULL,
  shared_label = "Shared",
  shared_color = "#E64B35",
  unshared_color = "#F0F3F8",
  na_color = "white",
  border_color = "#DCE2EC",
  border_size = 0.25,
  legend_title = "Dyad Status",
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = NULL
)

Arguments

status_col

Column name specifying the binary or categorical sharing status (e.g. "Shared", "Unique", "Persistent").

shared_label

Label indicating sharing or transmission (default "Shared").

shared_color

Color for shared or transmitted state (default "#E64B35").

unshared_color

Color for unshared state (default "#F0F3F8").

na_color

Color for missing or unmeasured cells (default "white").

border_color

Cell outline color (default "#DCE2EC").

border_size

Cell outline stroke width (default 0.25).

legend_title

Title for the legend (default "Transmission").

xlab, ylab

Axis labels.

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Simulated mother-infant dyad sharing data
set.seed(42)
dyad_df <- expand.grid(
  Species = c("S. epidermidis", "S. hominis", "C. acnes", "M. restricta"),
  Dyad = paste0("Dyad_", 1:12)
)
dyad_df$Status <- ifelse(runif(nrow(dyad_df)) > 0.45, "Shared", "Not shared")

cliplot(Species ~ Dyad, data = dyad_df,
        type = type_sharing_heatmap(status_col = "Status"))
} # }
